subject: Veridian Health — private deploy orchestration and network preflight
messages:
From: Alice Moore <alice.moore@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment — initial network questions and files

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As we prep for the private deployment (VPC peering + appliance), ops asked me to share our initial network artifacts and a short set of questions to make sure we don't hit any surprises during the install window. Attached: veridian_vpc_diagram.pdf and our security_questionnaire.pdf.

Key asks up front:
- Do you provide a recommended NAT/egress IP range for VPC peers (we'd like to whitelist ahead of time)?
- For the on‑prem package: cert provisioning flow (we prefer to preinstall customer certs) and service account expectations.
- Private endpoints: is there an optional TLS reverse proxy you recommend for edge devices that can't reach Redwood directly?

We'd love to get a 30–45m preflight call next week to walk these items with your network lead and the on‑prem engineer. Our team can do Mon/Tue morning PT.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Moore
Director, Infrastructure Operations — Veridian Health
[Attachment: veridian_vpc_diagram.pdf (PDF, 740KB)]
[Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moore <alice.moore@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — initial network questions and files

Alice — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks.

Quick replies:
- We'll provide a recommended egress IP block and an optional static-range config for VPC peering.
- On‑prem package supports both preinstalled certs and an automated provisioning flow; we'll outline both options on the call.
- We do offer a lightweight TLS reverse proxy pattern for constrained edge devices — will bring the docs.

Proposed preflight cadence: 30min kickoff to align owners, then a 60min network deep-dive. Available slots (PT):
- Mon Sep 7, 08:30–09:15
- Mon Sep 7, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Sep 8, 09:00–10:00

Internal owners@Redwood:
- On‑prem package lead: Marissa Cole (will handle install packaging and cert flow)
- Network & VPC peer reviewer: Lauren Bishop (will run the network deep-dive)
- Customer success/engage: myself (overall runbook and timeline)

I've attached our redwood_onprem_runbook_template.md to speed the handoff. Please pick a slot and we'll send calendar invites.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_onprem_runbook_template.md (Markdown, 28KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian Health — internal owners & immediate next steps

Folks — summarizing internal action items following Alice's doc dump and my reply: 

1) Marissa: finalize on‑prem packaging checklist (target: draft by Thu 9/9)
   - Verify installer supports preinstalled cert + automated enrollment flow
   - Document disk/IO and RAM requirements for the appliance (Veridian provided expected concurrency numbers in questionnaire)

2) Lauren: prepare VPC peer security checklist and egress IP range proposal (target: Tue 9/8)
   - Generate sample peer config (vpc-peer-template.cfg) and a list of recommended routes/ACLs
   - Confirm if we need separate peer endpoints per region or single multi‑AZ peer will suffice

3) Me: create runbook skeleton (I will push the initial pages into the shared Drive link and create the call agenda)

Meeting logistics: I'll provision the calendar event once Lauren confirms the Tue slot. Bring the sample traffic matrix if you have it.

Thanks — K

---
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager

From: Alice Moore <alice.moore@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — initial network questions and files

Thanks — Karthik and team. Tue Sep 8, 09:00 PT works for us.

A couple follow ups from our networking side (short):
- Attached is our egress and firewall policy extract (veridian-egress-requirements.xlsx). You'll see we require inbound TLS only from whitelisted IPs. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a single static IP block for peering, or do you require a dynamically scaled set?
- Certificate note: we do not want any third‑party CA provisioning during initial install. We will provide our internal CA bundle and would like instructions for pre-installing certs into the appliance.
- For the reverse proxy option: our devices are NATed behind customer networks and will not push client certs. The proxy needs to terminate TLS and authenticate via a signed token. Do you have a recommended proxy image or a reference architecture?

Attaching the egress spreadsheet for Lauren's review.

Alice
[Attachment: veridian-egress-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 56KB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moore <alice.moore@veridianhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — network deep-dive confirmation and artifacts

Hi Alice — great to meet you all this morning. Quick follow up and artifacts from our side: 

- We've confirmed we can offer a single static egress IP block for the peering session. I'll attach the sample config and the CIDR range in the Drive folder.
- Attached: vpc-peer-template.cfg (sample peer config), and a short network checklist PDF I pushed to the shared runbook.
- Certificate/installer: Marissa will share the preinstall steps; short version: place PEM bundle in /etc/redwood/certs/ and run redwood‑installer --preinstall-cert <bundle>. We will not call out to any third party CA during initial install.
- Reverse proxy: we recommend the lightweight TLS proxy (edge-proxy v0.9) with signed JWT auth. Reference: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Veridian/edge-proxy-pattern (I put a one-page diagram there).

Next steps:
- Marissa: share preinstall commands and the appliance resource matrix by Thu 9/10.
- Karthik: finalize runbook skeleton and publish meeting notes to the Drive.

Links and artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Veridian/implementation-runbook
DocuSign order-form (provisional): https://docusign.com/VER-1793/order-form

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Network Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vpc-peer-template.cfg (CFG, 3KB)]
